lines.text: Many learners say: Please write your sign here.
Better: Please write your signature here.
Your name in your own writing is a signature.
Signature! Please write your signature here.

data.why: Your name in your own writing is a signature.

native.tip: 名前を書く「サイン」は名詞で signature。動詞なら sign here。
native.caption: “Please write your sign here.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語の「サイン」をそのまま sign と言いがちです。“Please write your signature here.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“signature”。“Please write your signature here.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: The ``sign'' used to write one's name is a noun. If it's a verb, sign here.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Please write your sign here.” 😅 Use signature as the word for your name. The natural way is “Please write your signature here.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
